name: 12540 · Lagrangeville, NY
findings: ZIP 12540 (Lagrangeville) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12540 (Lagrangeville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 12540 (Lagrangeville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
